description: Example, not yet run: the installed native participant's opt-in text HTTP API (docs/native-participant.md), mounted by the host application. Answers go through the existing requester, its admission, disclosure authorization and the prepared route; the API takes no sampling overrides.
protocolNotes: chat-completions sends model, messages, stream:false. messages also reports raw-model-token usage (prompt and output token counts) and needs maxTokens within the route's prepared allocation.
declaredPlacement: Operator-declared route, for example the signed ordered three-stage route and the hosts serving each stage. The API does not report placement.
